description: Personal build of HushFacebook 0.23.1 (128 patches) for Facebook 587.0.0.39.55 - the Google Play build (com.facebook.katana). Based on SysAdminDoc/HushFacebook (GPL-3.0), plus: iOS 27 Liquid Glass tab bar, split-screen half-and-half comments on Reels, Reels top-bar return from Clean mode, Following feed home and the personal defaults. Upstream 0.23.0 removed the OPEN_COMMENTS_FULL_HEIGHT setting (replaced by the COMMENTS_HEIGHT list setting). Needs Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK.
